Title: Customer Experience Manager
Company: Acme Cloud
URL: https://acmecloud.example/jobs/cx

Acme Cloud builds B2B customer engagement software. We're hiring a Customer Experience Manager to lead our CX program.

Requirements:
- 5+ years in customer experience or customer success
- Salesforce Service Cloud expertise
- Experience with NPS/CSAT measurement (Medallia preferred)
- Cross-functional stakeholder management
- Data-driven decision making (SQL a plus)

Compensation: $135,000 - $165,000 + equity
Location: Remote (US)

Title: Customer Experience Manager
Company: Brightwave Software
URL: https://brightwave.example/jobs/cx

Brightwave Software builds customer engagement tools for the world's best companies. We need a Customer Experience Manager to drive CX improvements across our platform.

Requirements:
- 5+ years of CX or customer success experience
- Salesforce and CRM expertise
- Medallia or similar survey platform experience
- Strong stakeholder management skills
- Analytical mindset (SQL, data visualization)

Compensation: $140,000 - $170,000 + equity
Location: Remote (US)

Title: Customer Experience Manager
Company: Riverstone CRM
URL: https://riverstone.example/jobs/cx

Riverstone CRM is a customer relationship platform. We're looking for a Customer Experience Manager to own our customer experience program.

Requirements:
- 5+ years in customer experience management
- Salesforce administration
- Survey and feedback tools (Medallia, Gainsight)
- Cross-team collaboration and stakeholder management
- SQL and data analysis skills

Compensation: $138,000 - $168,000 + equity
Location: Remote (US)

groups.description: Same CX Manager role at one company, varying only the remote policy -- scores should differentiate (remote > hybrid > onsite).

scoring.notes: Identical except remote policy. Remote earns the bonus; onsite earns the penalty. Variance is expected and correct here.
